external_entities.name: member
external_entities.description: A library member who borrows, renews and reserves books through the library app.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Members borrow, renew and reserve books through the library app on their phones.

external_entities.name: desk staff
external_entities.description: Library desk staff who change loan and member account records through the circulation page.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Desk staff can extend a loan, clear a block on a member's account or mark a book as returned by hand
external_entities.notes: Everyone at the desk uses the same shared login; individual staff and branch cannot be identified from the history.

processes.name: library app
processes.description: A phone application through which members request borrowing, renewals and reservations.
processes.source_excerpt: The app on their phone calls the lending API.

processes.name: self-service kiosk
processes.description: A branch kiosk where members scan their library card and books being borrowed or returned.
processes.source_excerpt: The kiosks are in every branch and they send each loan and each return to the lending API as it is scanned.

processes.name: lending API
processes.description: The REST service that is the sole interface for changing loans and that reads and writes the loans database.
processes.source_excerpt: It's a REST API. JSON in, JSON out.
processes.notes: Lending service note states: "The lending API is internal-only." Interview transcript states: "The phones talk straight to the lending API over the internet." These are conflicting positive claims about exposure, so exposure remains unknown. Authentication is also uncertain: Priya said, "I think it checks a token the app gets at sign-in" and could not say what it accepts or does with rejected calls.

data_stores.name: loans database
data_stores.description: The single database containing members, loans, reservations, names, email addresses, home addresses and full borrowing history.
data_stores.source_excerpt: Names, email addresses, home addresses and every member's full borrowing history live in the loans database.
data_stores.notes: The earlier statement about two databases was corrected: "We merged those in the spring. It's one loans database now. The old reservations database is gone."

data_flows.name: change loans
data_flows.description: A member uses the library app to request borrowing, renewal or reservation changes through the lending API.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The app on their phone calls the lending API. It says which book and which member, and the API checks the loan rules and writes the change.
data_flows.data_description: Book, member and borrowing or reservation change

data_flows.name: send loans
data_flows.description: A self-service kiosk sends loan and return records to the lending API as books are scanned.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The kiosks send each loan and each return to the lending API.
data_flows.notes: Priya could not say whether the kiosks also talk directly to the loans database: "I couldn't tell you what they talk to these days. I only ever see what arrives at the API."
data_flows.data_description: Loan and return records, including scanned library card and book information

data_flows.name: change account
data_flows.description: Desk staff use the circulation page served by the lending API to extend loans, clear account blocks and mark books returned.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Someone at the desk opens the circulation page and marks it returned, or clears the block on the account.
data_flows.notes: The circulation page uses one shared desk login; the page does not ask again and history records that the loan was closed by hand.

data_flows.name: read-write loans
data_flows.description: The lending API reads and writes the loans database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The API is the only thing that reads or writes it.
data_flows.data_description: Member records, loans, reservations and borrowing history

trust_boundaries.name: branch network
trust_boundaries.description: The network on which branch self-service kiosks and desk staff operate.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The kiosks sit on the branch network.

trust_boundaries.name: council data centre
trust_boundaries.description: The council data-centre zone where the lending API and loans database run.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The lending API and the loans database run in the council data centre.

assumptions.assumption: The contents of the loans database are confidential because it contains names, email addresses, home addresses and full borrowing history.
assumptions.basis: The interview states that the loans database contains personal addresses and member borrowing history.
